values.binNote: Total single-target damage is a tooltip aggregate (7.5x base per-bolt values over the storm's duration with the damage-amp ramp included), not a direct bin field; PerTickDamageCalculated and KennenRDuration/KennenRTickRate/DamageAmp together produce it but no single bin row states it.

values.quote: summons a storm around himself for 3 seconds
strikes lightning bolts down on nearby enemies every {{fd|0.5}} seconds
gains 10% additional damage for each subsequent strike a target has received, up to a combined total of 150% of the initial strike's damage
values.binNote: DamageAmp=0.1 is the per-strike increment stated by the bin; the wiki-stated cap of 150% (1.5) total additional damage is not itself a separate bin row and is only described in the tooltip text.
